title: Principia Artificialis: An open research program on the mathematical foundations of artificial intelligence
description: An open, AI-assisted research notes program on the mathematics of artificial reasoning and verification. The corpus includes speculative proposals, literature intakes, registered experiments, and preserved negative results. Preregistration, anti-vacuity controls, and test evidence are documented per note where applicable; neither experimental verification nor independent reproduction is implied for every note. AI contributions are attributed in the repository.
